notes: Official Australian GYG allergen, ingredient, and nutritional information PDF, created May 20, 2026 and linked from https://www.guzmanygomez.com.au/nutrition/.
Nutrition is based on standard products, average serving size, supplier information, product analysis, and government databases; GYG says values may vary by supplier, season, and product variation.

Serving sizes differ by format. Add-ons are regular burrito/bowl/salad extras only and should not be blindly applied to minis or brekkie items.
